An open-source coding model has been released that outperforms Claude Opus 4.7 on key benchmarks

DeepReinforce has released Ornith-1.0, a family of open-source models tailored for agent encoding. There are four variants: 9B Dense, 31B Dense, 35B MoE, and 397B MoE. Based on Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5.

The key idea of the model is that it learns not only to solve tasks but also to build scenarios for their solutions. Conventional models receive a ready-made "framework" of how to approach the task and work with it. Ornith generates and improves it during the training process.

The flagship 397B version scored 77.5 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 82.4 on SWE-Bench Verified. Claude Opus 4.7 on the same tests shows 70.3 and 80.8.

The 35B version outperforms Qwen 3.5-397B on Terminal-Bench, meaning a model eleven times smaller in parameters works better on this test.

The 9B variant, which runs on regular hardware, outperforms Gemma 4-31B on several benchmarks.

All models are available on Hugging Face.

Binance has warned its European users that it will stop providing crypto services in the EU after failing to secure a MiCA license before the deadline

On June 24, the exchange withdrew its license application in Greece and announced plans to apply in another EU country. However, with MiCA rules fully taking effect on July 1, time has run out. 

In emails sent to users, Binance's European entity stated that it can no longer accept new clients and will cease providing crypto-asset services from July 1, 2026.

Users in Poland, Italy, Spain, and France have already received instructions on how to withdraw their funds. 

Binance founder Changpeng Zhao criticized the decision, saying it's "sad to see the European Union deprive its users of access to the best liquidity in the world."

For now, this looks like a major setback for Binance in Europe and another reminder that regulation is becoming one of the biggest challenges for global crypto exchanges.

🔔 What are “the trenches”? A guide to Solana memecoin culture and slang 

⚠️ If you spend any time around Solana memecoins, you will hear about “the trenches.” It is where traders called degens fight over brand-new tokens that mostly go to zero, in a culture with its own language, rituals, and brutal economics. Here is what the trenches are, the slang you need to follow them, and the hard reality behind the romance.

➡️ “The trenches” is crypto slang for the chaotic, high-risk frontier of on-chain memecoin trading, especially the world of brand-new Solana tokens launched on platforms like Pumpfun, where traders fight for fast profits amid rampant scams, bots, and a flood of coins that mostly go to zero. 

📊 The phrase is a war metaphor, and it is chosen deliberately. To be “in the trenches” is to be down in the mud of the riskiest, fastest, most unforgiving part of crypto, trading tokens that are minutes old, against opponents who include automated bots and seasoned predators, where fortunes are made and lost in the time it takes to read a chart. It is a culture as much as an activity, with its own dense vocabulary, its own rituals and heroes, and its own grim economics.

🤖 How an MEV bot quietly robs you on an EVM DEX — and why it can't on GalaSwap

Every time you swap on Uniswap, PancakeSwap, or any EVM DEX, you're not just trading against the pool. You're trading in front of an audience of predatory bots. Here's exactly how they skim your trade, step by step:

1️⃣ You broadcast your swap. It doesn't execute instantly — it lands in the public mempool, a glass waiting room where every pending transaction is visible to anyone watching. That includes hundreds of MEV bots scanning in real time.

2️⃣ A searcher spots you. It calculates: "jump in front, move the price against them, dump right after for a guaranteed profit." It fires two transactions — one before you, one after — and bids higher gas to lock in that ordering.

3️⃣ You get sandwiched. The bot buys *first* (price ↑), your order fills at the worse price, and it sells *immediately after* into the demand you created. You paid more. It pocketed the difference.

4️⃣ The tax is invisible. You never see a "sandwiched" line — it just looks like slippage. But it isn't bad luck. It's a designed feature of how EVM chains order transactions. Bots have extracted billions this way, block after block, from ordinary traders who did nothing wrong.

That's the dirty secret of "permissionless" DEXs: the order flow is a public target, and the fastest, highest-bidding bot eats first.

⚡️ GalaSwap deletes the attack surface entirely.

GalaSwap runs on GalaChain, and its architecture removes the two things that make
sandwiching possible:
✅ No public mempool — your pending swap isn't broadcast to a room bots can read. There's nothing to snipe.
✅ No gas-priority auction — execution is deterministic and validator-ordered. Nobody can *pay* to jump in front of your trade.

Take away the mempool and the ordering auction, and the sandwich has nothing to grab. The price you see is the price you get — no searcher skimming your fill, no invisible tax, no "why did that cost more than the quote." Whale or first-timer, everyone gets the same fair execution.

Stop feeding the bots. 🟡

Good afternoon from LAX.

As I wait to board my flight to Seattle, Washington, ahead of our July 3–10 Alaska Cruise, I wanted to encourage you with these words:

Even when things look bad - and trust me, they are - our Lord is still on the throne, and His will shall be accomplished.

The best way to navigate life in these days is to remember these simple truths:

Evil triumphs only temporarily. The wicked may flourish for a season, but their end is certain, while the righteous will flourish in the Lord. (Psalm 92:7–15 NKJV)
Never grow weary in doing good. “And let us not grow weary while doing good, for in due season we shall reap if we do not lose heart.” (Galatians 6:9 NKJV)

I won’t pretend these past three years have been easy. There were many moments when I felt as though I was barely keeping my head above water. What sustained me was the Lord, my family, and the incredible team with whom I have the privilege of serving.

Remaining in God’s Word - and teaching it from Israel and around the world - has been one of the greatest sources of strength in my life. The promise of Scripture became my daily reality:

“For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.” (2 Timothy 1:7 NKJV)

Fear was never my struggle. Sadness was.

Sadness as I watched millions of people blinded, deceived, and manipulated by the prince of this world. Sadness as I saw many who claim to know God’s Word twist it, rip it from its context, and lead countless people into deception and doctrines of demons. (1 Timothy 4:1)

Never forget this: Israel remains one of the clearest spiritual litmus tests for both the Church and the nations. How people respond to God’s covenant people often reveals far more than their political opinions - it exposes their spiritual condition.

Jesus warned that His return would come when the world was spiritually indifferent and unprepared. Therefore, He commanded us to watch, be ready, and live expectantly.

“Therefore you also be ready, for the Son of Man is coming at an hour you do not expect.” (Matthew 24:44 NKJV)

That is why I count it such a privilege and blessing to soon board a cruise ship with more than 700 believers who have gathered for one purpose: to worship the Lord, enjoy fellowship with one another, and diligently study His Word together.

Thank you for allowing my team and me to be part of your journey through these extraordinary days in which we live.

On a personal note, I also want to thank everyone who responded to my request at the end of last month by committing to pray for our ministry and by supporting it financially.

Your partnership enables us to continue proclaiming God’s Word around the world without compromise, and I am deeply grateful.

As James reminds us:

“Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and comes down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation or shadow of turning.” (James 1:17 NKJV)

To Him alone be all the glory.

Awaiting His Return
